opportunities.title: Main Grants

amount.raw: up to £500,000 (up to £750,000 in special cases)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be UK‑based organisations (or institutions) with a formal employment or contractual relationship for the project duration. Individuals without such a relationship, schools, further education colleges, undergraduates, master’s students, PhD fee projects, establishment of academic posts, ongoing costs, local charities, and overseas organisations (except exceptional cases) are not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Research, Development and Analysis Fund offering up to £500,000 (special cases up to £750,000) for projects addressing any of the Foundation’s five priority questions. Two application deadlines per year (Spring and Autumn). Next deadline 5 Oct 2026.

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to individuals and organisations, especially those from racially minoritised communities. Partnership applications that bring together researchers and racially minoritised communities are strongly encouraged.
opportunities.summary: Supports research on racial diversity within the UK, focusing on inter‑generational changes, continuities and challenges. Priority theme for 2026: inter‑generational changes, continuities and challenges in a racially diverse UK.
